subject: german
title: Bigger Numbers

walkthroughs.body_html: 30 dreissig, 40 vierzig, 50 funfzig, 60 sechzig, 70 siebzig, 80 achtzig, 90 neunzig. Most add -zig.
German says digits backwards! 21 = einundzwanzig (one-and-twenty). 35 = funfunddreissig (five-and-thirty). Keep practising — it gets natural.
'Ich bin 13 Jahre alt' = I am 13 years old. Ich bin = I am. Notice you use 'I am' here (unlike French 'I have').

mcqs.q: Where does the main verb go in 'Ich kann gut Deutsch sprechen'?
options: At the end of the clause (sprechen).
